Q1: What should happen when a held PR's head has a `findings` marker but no open `ai:security` follow-up for its branch (matched by the `Integration branch: <ref>` line)?
Choices:
A) The gate holds with a new reason, `followups_missing`, which is left out of the mute list so the judge sends a CRITICAL alert. Closed issues are not reopened, because a collaborator closing one may be a deliberate waiver. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A, and the gate also reopens the closed follow-up issues and notes the reopen on the PR. It still sends an alert if the follow-ups are closed a second time on the same head.
C) A, and the gate also starts a fresh audit of the unchanged head. Closed follow-ups would no longer suppress the security-audit dedupe for that branch, so their findings are filed again.
Q2: When follow-ups are still open but the head has not changed, how long should the gate wait before it stops muting `awaiting_followups` and sends an alert?
Choices:
A) Add a new variable, `SECURITY_PASS_FOLLOWUP_STALE_HOURS`, defaulting to `24`. The clock starts at the `findings` marker's timestamp; that is long enough for a follow-up to run clarify, plan, implement and review. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Reuse the existing `SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS` (default `6`).
C) No time limit. Only alert when the follow-ups are missing (Q1).
